sources.title: Image to Prompt Generator (Free AI) - MiniWebtool
sources.snippet: AI Image to Prompt Generator - Describe an image for another generation tool with MiniWebtool’s AI Image to Prompt Generator. An uploaded reference produces platform-oriented prompts and a breakdown of style, lighting, and camera choices, plus a video-prompt version.

sources.title: AI Image-to-Prompt Generator (Free) | Convly
sources.snippet: Free AI image-to-prompt generator: upload any image and get a detailed prompt, a style breakdown, and Midjourney/Stable Diffusion settings to recreate the look.
